summary: Frontend testing of iter408 People-page Staff tab (/5812global/members). All 8 requested checks PASS: the Staff tab shows for a system admin (admin@5812uganda.org) and lists 9 rows with name/email/job role/Admin/Active. Search by name ('ssekito'), email ('zipporah.zaituni@') and role ('coordinator') each narrows to 1 row. The role filter 'Manager' returns Zipporah only; 'Admins only' returns Katelyn and Silvester. Admin grant on Christopher Ssekito (Coordinator): badge appears, role stays Coordinator, and both still hold after a reload. Changing his job role to Manager while he is an admin persisted after a reload with admin kept. After changing back to Coordinator and turning Admin off, the badge is gone and the role is back to Coordinator, also after a reload. This confirms the iter266 job-title preservation fix. Non-admin Manager (zipporah.zaituni@gmail.com / Test@5812!) sees no Staff tab, and Guests, Families and Children work for her. Admin regression: all 6 tabs switch correctly with no console errors. Comms search 'zipp' filters the Organization list to 1 and self is never listed. Self-service profile photo upload works ('Photo updated'). At 390px the Staff tab has no horizontal overflow. The owner row (silvesterlubwama@icloud.com) cannot be seen from an org admin session because the owner belongs to no organisation, so the Owner read-only branch was only checked by code review (renders an Owner badge and no switches; the backend also returns 403). Side effects found in the backend (below).

minor.issue: Every inline save from the Staff tab (Admin switch, Active switch, job-role select) regenerates and overwrites `title`, because the tab never sends `title` and admin_update_user calls generate_title(role) without the user's locations. Observed: Christopher's title went 'admin' -> 'Coordinator'. Zipporah's custom 'Operations Manager' or Katelyn's 'Director of 58:12 Uganda' would be lost just by toggling Active. For an admin-tier user, a job-role change regenerates the title from role='admin', so it becomes literally 'admin'. Fix: only regenerate the title when role/location/department actually change, or have the tab send the existing title back.
`updated_at` is computed but never written to users: it is not in ACCOUNT_FIELDS, so user_update drops it. Christopher's users.updated_at stayed 2026-10-07 after 4 edits.

The Staff tab lists 9 accounts, but the org has 16 users and the Comms Organization list shows 10. Missing: System Admin (admin@5812global.org), the signed-in Admin (admin@5812uganda.org), 4 'OnlyName' Staff and Portal Test Member. Likely cause is the campus/location filter or accounts that have no location_id. Decide whether accounts with no location should appear on the Staff list. Right now an admin cannot manage those accounts from this tab.

integration_issues.issue: setAdmin(off) sends only {role: jobRole} and leaves secondary_roles=[jobRole] behind on the users and members docs. Observed: Christopher ended with secondary_roles ['Coordinator'] (it was []) after the round trip. setAdmin(on) also REPLACES the whole secondary_roles array with [jobRole], so any existing secondary roles are lost. setJobRole for admins does the same. Fix: on OFF send secondary_roles minus the job role; on ON or role change prepend or replace only index 0.

action_items: Stop Staff-tab saves overwriting custom `title` (admin_update_user regenerates the title on every PUT, and gives 'admin' for admin-tier users)
On Admin OFF clear the job role from secondary_roles, and do not wipe other secondary roles on Admin ON or a job-role change
Write updated_at to users in admin_update_user (add it to the user_update set)
Decide whether accounts with no location (admin@5812global.org, the signed-in admin) should appear on the Staff list; today GET /api/admin/users drops them
critical_code_review_comments: StaffListTab: front-end ADMIN_TIER is ['admin','system_admin'], but the backend admin tier also includes 'Executive Director'. Executive Director rows show the Admin switch OFF, and only a system admin can save one.

StaffListTab.save merges the request payload into local state instead of the server response, so server-side changes such as the regenerated title are not reflected until a reload. Use the returned user.
StaffListTab sorts by name on the client while the backend already sorts. Harmless.
UnifiedPeoplePage passes canEdit={isSystemAdmin}, which is the same gate as the tab, so the read-only branch is only reachable for super_admin rows. Fine.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested checks (8/8); 3 minor backend and 1 integration side effects found
